title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 5) Order 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) (No. 5) Order 2022 and comes into operation on 30 December 2022.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The parts of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule are declared to be a precinct for the purpose of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
All those parts of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Lorong Melayu, Jalan Daud and Lengkong Tiga, comprised in Lot number 04455K in Mukim 23 and on which Apartment Blocks 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108 and 109 are erected, and in Lot number 04170V in Mukim 23 and on which Apartment Blocks 110, 111, 112, 113, 114, 115 and 116 are erected, and which are more particularly edged in the Plan.
THE PLAN
LENGKONG TIGA
